Selling a gift card online comes down to two questions. Will the platform pay? Is the price fair? Prestmit has more than 1 million traders and 2.5 million app downloads, which makes both worth answering properly. This review covers what the rates look like, how the money reaches sellers, what verification involves and who the platform suits. What Prestmit does Prestmit is one of Nigeria’s leading gift card trading platforms. A seller submits a card, Prestmit verifies it, then pays out in naira, cedis, dollars or crypto. The app also converts crypto to cash and runs an OTC desk for crypto trades from $3,000. On the everyday side it sells discounted airtime, data and eSIMs, turns unused airtime back into cash, funds betting accounts and pays electricity and cable TV bills. More than 10,000 gift card accepted on Prestmit Prestmit trades more than 10,000 gift cards, each priced by issuer country and denomination. A US card and a UK card of the same face value are worth different amounts. Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. Add us to your Preferred Sources Rates you can check before trading Prestmit Gift card rates are published for every brand it trades, so no account is needed and no card has to be submitted before a seller knows what their card is worth. Bitget Wallet expands payment options with stablecoin-powered virtual card Asset managers, banks consider stablecoin services Experts list digital asset risks, caution against fraudsters Fast payouts, several routes Payout lands within five minutes of a card clearing verification. Where it goes is the seller’s choice: – Naira, into a Prestmit naira wallet and out to a bank account – Ghanaian cedis, into a Prestmit cedis wallet, for sellers in Ghana – US dollars, into a Prestmit USD wallet – Crypto, in Bitcoin, USDT, Litecoin or Dogecoin, sent to the wallet address entered at the point of trade, which cannot be changed afterwards Who Prestmit is for – Anyone with a gift card to sell – Regular sellers moving cards across many brands and regions – High-volume crypto traders, priced directly by the OTC desk from $3,000 a trade – Businesses and developers adding gift card trading to their own product through the API The verdict Yes. Prestmit is a safe place to sell gift cards. The evidence is specific: rates published before you trade, every card verified before money moves, payout on approval and quick support.
